title: What the live paper record shows
description: The engines' own state, read from the running record: what is open, what closed, and what the market filter is doing right now.
body:
Paper signals only. No real orders are placed anywhere in this record. This note reports the engines' own state as read from the running record: what is open, what closed, and what the market filter is doing right now. 1 trade says nothing about a strategy, and every position here is paper.

## Paper framing and scope

The framing comes first. Paper signals only. No real orders are placed anywhere in this record. v005 counts its live record from 1 October 2026, and v006 counts its live record from 9 October 2026. The first live signal was an ATOM entry at 2.066 after the 10 October 2026 daily close. The rule for that entry's exit was a close below the 10-day low; the measurement was the 18 October 2026 close at 1.703; the result was −17.9% after the 30 bps round trip. A NEAR entry at 5.896 on 12 October 2026 has been open since. In testing, a losing start is the expected case rather than a surprise, and the average winner was roughly +19%. The same numbers appear on the performance page, in the signal log, and in the status posted to the channel.

## Open positions and recent entries

Open positions are counted from the engine state. htf-rsi-v007 shows 0 positions open on paper. trend-daily-v005 shows 0 positions open on paper. trend-daily-v006 shows 0 positions open on paper. The named open entry is NEAR at 5.896 from 12 October 2026. The ATOM entry at 2.066 from 10 October 2026 is not open; it closed at 1.703 on 18 October 2026. With 0 positions open on paper for htf-rsi-v007, trend-daily-v005, and trend-daily-v006, the live record at this read shows no open paper positions in those engines. NEAR remains the entry at 5.896 from 12 October 2026. The ATOM entry at 2.066 from 10 October 2026 is already closed at 1.703. A 0 open count is a state reading, not a verdict on the entries that came before it.

## Closed trades and realized results

Closed trades are reported with counts and averages. htf-rsi-v007 has 4 closed trades so far, with average null net per trade. trend-daily-v005 has 6 closed trades so far, with average −13.22% net per trade. trend-daily-v006 has 7 closed trades so far, with average −13.34% net per trade. The ATOM trade is one of those closed results: entry at 2.066 after the 10 October 2026 daily close, exit below the 10-day low at the 18 October 2026 close at 1.703, result −17.9% after the 30 bps round trip. The averages are −13.22% for trend-daily-v005 and −13.34% for trend-daily-v006. htf-rsi-v007 shows 4 closed trades and an average null net per trade. These are realized results from the paper record, not projections. The ATOM result of −17.9% sits alongside the trend-daily averages of −13.22% and −13.34%. The count of closed trades is 4, 6, and 7. The record does not say why any single trade won or lost; it records the entry, the exit rule, the exit price, and the net result.

## Market filter and near-breakout distances

Market filter state is part of the live record. trend-daily-v005 has the Bitcoin market filter off. trend-daily-v006 has the Bitcoin market filter off. The nearest distances to a 20-day breakout are also listed. For trend-daily-v005, AVAXUSDT is 8.56% below its high, TRXUSDT is 11.41% below its high, and XLMUSDT is 15.20% below its high. For trend-daily-v006, JUPUSDT is 8.39% below its high, AVAXUSDT is 8.56% below its high, and TRXUSDT is 11.41% below its high. These distances are measured against the 20-day breakout level. The filter is off for both trend-daily engines. The nearest names are AVAXUSDT at 8.56%, TRXUSDT at 11.41%, and XLMUSDT at 15.20% for v005, and JUPUSDT at 8.39%, AVAXUSDT at 8.56%, and TRXUSDT at 11.41% for v006. The record states the filter state and the distances; it does not state a cause for the filter being off.

## Record continuity and where to verify

The snapshot time is part of the record. This live snapshot was read at 2026-11-14T21:07:50.756Z. The record updates continuously. The same numbers appear on the performance page, in the signal log, and in the status posted to the channel. v005 counts its live record from 1 October 2026, and v006 counts its live record from 9 October 2026. The first live signal remains an ATOM entry at 2.066 after the 10 October 2026 daily close. ATOM exited below its 10-day low at the 18 October 2026 close at 1.703, which is −17.9% after the 30 bps round trip. NEAR at 5.896 on 12 October 2026 has been open since. htf-rsi-v007 has 0 positions open on paper and 4 closed trades with average null net per trade. trend-daily-v005 has the Bitcoin market filter off, 0 positions open on paper, and 6 closed trades with average −13.22% net per trade. trend-daily-v006 has the Bitcoin market filter off, 0 positions open on paper, and 7 closed trades with average −13.34% net per trade. The nearest 20-day breakout distances remain AVAXUSDT 8.56%, TRXUSDT 11.41%, XLMUSDT 15.20%, JUPUSDT 8.39%, AVAXUSDT 8.56%, and TRXUSDT 11.41%. All of these numbers appear on the performance page and in the signal log.
